name: Brooklyn Lane
source: The cool goth barista everyone has dreamed of. Talented in drawing, programming, and anything else she takes interest in. Yet, she yearns for more: in politics, romance, and at the university's debate club. As her junior year starts, she figures out just what could bring herself some more joy in life.
